goals: Keep Lantern crew alive and Beacon at least 2
Require civilian scrutiny of military operations

messages.text: I want Guild discretion secured, not a permanent compulsory carriage duty dressed as recognition. We have waited fourteen years. Our ordinary trade and maintenance can demonstrate that independent Guild management keeps a route functioning. I favour joint military authority because someone must be able to refuse destructive operations.

reason: Our ships and trained navigators are our bargaining strength. I will accept a specific useful voyage where the bargain warrants it, but not surrender continuing traffic control merely to satisfy an army demand. Commercial commitments count as real obligations. A sound beacon and surviving crews matter more than flattering an imperial directive.
